prompts.motherClosed: Use attached children's storybook art as STYLE reference only. Generate one full-body CARTOON MOTHER character, isolated genuine transparent RGBA background, portrait canvas. Warm paper-collage gouache watercolor illustration, not photo. Friendly East Asian mother with rounded softly stylized face, dark brown hair in low bun, rust terracotta knit cardigan with cream small rounded collar and buttons, sage-green calf-length skirt, cream stockings and tan flat shoes. Adult proportions around 4.5 heads tall, consistent anatomy, warm gentle curious smile. Facing front slightly toward viewer's left; elbows bent, BOTH hands visibly CLOSED into soft fists extended separately forward at waist level, fists side by side with a gap, knuckles forward, thumbs resting over fingers; a guessing-game pose. Full hair and shoes visible, generous margins; ground contact level, no cast background/shadow plate. No child, no stone visible, no floating objects, no landscape, no text, no border. Preserve the illustrated world's paper texture and muted warm palette. This adult will always remain a cartoon, never a real photo.

prompts.boulder: Generate a separate picturebook PROP on genuine transparent RGBA background. Style of attached reference: warm watercolor gouache, layered paper texture, sage moss, softly painted stone. One low broad gray-brown garden boulder with a shallow overhang and moss along top, grounded three-quarter front view, and ONE small smooth pale cream-gray oval pebble tucked just under its overhang, clearly visible. Large boulder about 8 times pebble width. The small pebble must look ordinary, no face. Sparse tiny grass only at the base. Keep boulder compact, occupying central 80% of a wide landscape canvas, complete silhouette with generous transparent margins. No garden background, no other stones, no characters, hands, faces, text, labels or frame. This is for a child discovering a little stone under a big stone.
prompts.sunFrame: New illustration asset for a children's picture book, using attached picture ONLY as warm watercolor/gouache cut-paper-texture STYLE reference. Square 1:1 canvas. A cozy cottage interior with a large floor-to-ceiling open green wooden French window/door on the RIGHT occupying x=43–94% and y=9–71% of canvas. This opening is a TRUE TRANSPARENT HOLE to composite distant sunrise scenery behind; do not draw any sky, landscape, glass, gradients, white fill or checkerboard inside opening. Window has open side shutters and a gently arched top, no bars across clear central view. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE in room opaque: warm cream plaster walls, low warm wooden flooring in lower 30%, green curtain held aside, small stool with a folded knitted blanket at far left, simple wall shelf with two books, plant near left edge. Broad empty floor at x=15–40%, y=60–95% reserved for independent child character. Quiet early morning interior softly illuminated, muted warm ochres and greens, no glaring sunlight cast shadows yet. No people, bodies, heads, faces, stars, sun, moon, text, border or numbers. Crop fills entire square edge-to-edge. Genuine alpha ONLY inside the open view hole, plus none outside the rectangular canvas. It will be reused unchanged for 7 sunrise pages.
prompts.sunNight: Create a vertical 2:3 outdoor landscape painting for the view through a cottage window in a preschool picture book. Style reference supplied: delicate watercolor/gouache cut-paper texture, muted colors, painterly handmade paper. No room or window frame, no characters, no text. Scene BEFORE SUNRISE: dark indigo-violet sky occupies upper 64% of the image, soft thin long blue-gray horizontal cloud centered at x55%, y47%, no red light yet. A gently rolling, nearly level distant horizon at y65%, blue-green fields and distant cypress silhouettes below, tiny cream village roofs in lower 20%, quiet safe garden ambiance. Very faint gray-lavender light near horizon but sky clearly still dark. Absolutely NO sun, red disc, moon or star. Keep exact horizon and identifiable silhouettes easy to preserve in later dawn stages. Fill all edges, no blank paper region. No giant mountain, no dramatic cliffs. Gentle calm early morning, darker than day but visible details.
prompts.sunRedCloud: Edit supplied pre-dawn garden scene to the NEXT MOMENT, preserve EXACT canvas, framing, geography, horizon silhouette, every tree/house/wall/flower and stone path in same positions, same gouache watercolor paper style. Sky remains mostly blue-violet with a faint peach glow near horizon. Ground remains pre-dawn dim. ABSOLUTELY NO SUN DISC anywhere, no moon, no round glowing orb, no stars. Story moment: child mistakes red CLOUD for sun, so the visible RED object must clearly have an irregular wispy CLOUD shape, stretched horizontally. Do not add objects, people, alter camera, or brighten whole landscape into daytime. Output opaque, same portrait aspect ratio.
prompts.sunGlow: Edit supplied red-cloud dawn scene to the next minute, preserving exact positions and sizes of entire landscape, tree, all houses/wall/garden and clouds. Keep same watercolor paper palette. Keep red cloud at same place but a little softer salmon pink; sky gently lightens from indigo to muted lavender. Frame/camera identical. This is the suspense page before the sun actually appears. No people/text or new scenery. Opaque portrait same size/aspect.
prompts.sunReveal: Edit the supplied dawn-glow scene to SUNRISE REVEAL. Preserve EXACT same landscape geometry, horizon, composition, sizes, silhouettes, houses, garden, paths, framing tree and watercolor/cut-paper style. At the existing glow center x63%, y~49%, show a clearly recognizable warm coral-orange ROUND SUN emerging above the distant ridge, lower 15% hidden by the ridge. Gentle warm morning light brightens sky to lavender-peach and softly warms garden; keep muted storybook colors, no intense flare or photoreal glow. The sun must clearly differ from the irregular red cloud on earlier page. Do not move mountain/horizon or any objects. No people, text or new architecture. Same opaque portrait canvas.
